name: cloud-architect
description: Cloud Architect - cloud service selection + architecture across AWS / GCP / Azure (per-provider compute/storage/db/messaging decision matrices), multi-region + DR design (RTO/RPO tiers), cost architecture + bill-cut engagements (right-sizing, savings plans, egress traps), landing zones + account structure (AWS Orgs/SCPs, Azure ALZ, GCP FAST), org-level IAM architecture, migration (6R + waves), well-architected reviews.
